WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS d
  FROM `{{ $json.project }}.{{ $json.dataset }}.rate_metrics`
),
m AS (
  SELECT r.currency, r.rate_date, r.mid, r.chg_1w_pct, r.min_30d, r.max_30d, r.vol_30d_ann_pct
  FROM `{{ $json.project }}.{{ $json.dataset }}.rate_metrics` AS r, latest
  WHERE r.rate_date = latest.d
),
vol_1y AS (
  SELECT currency, ROUND(AVG(vol_30d_ann_pct), 2) AS vol_1y_avg_pct
  FROM `{{ $json.project }}.{{ $json.dataset }}.rate_metrics`, latest
  WHERE rate_date > DATE_SUB(latest.d, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  GROUP BY currency
),
pos AS (
  SELECT
    currency,
    COUNT(*)                                                  AS open_docs,
    SUM(signed_amount)                                        AS net_amount,
    SUM(current_pln)                                          AS net_pln,
    SUM(unrealised_pln)                                       AS unrealised_pln,
    SUM(IF(days_to_due < 0, signed_amount, 0))                AS overdue_amount,
    SUM(IF(days_to_due BETWEEN 0 AND 30, signed_amount, 0))   AS due_30d_amount
  FROM `{{ $json.project }}.{{ $json.dataset }}.exposure_positions`
  GROUP BY currency
),
week_ago AS (
  SELECT currency, unrealised_pln AS unrealised_week_ago
  FROM `{{ $json.project }}.{{ $json.dataset }}.exposure_daily`, latest
  WHERE rate_date <= DATE_SUB(latest.d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY rate_date DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  m.rate_date                                   AS report_date,
  m.currency,
  m.mid,
  m.chg_1w_pct,
  m.min_30d,
  m.max_30d,
  m.vol_30d_ann_pct,
  v.vol_1y_avg_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN m.vol_30d_ann_pct > v.vol_1y_avg_pct * 1.2 THEN 'above usual'
    WHEN m.vol_30d_ann_pct < v.vol_1y_avg_pct * 0.8 THEN 'below usual'
    ELSE 'usual'
  END                                           AS vol_level,
  COALESCE(p.open_docs, 0)                      AS open_docs,
  COALESCE(p.net_amount, 0)                     AS net_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(p.net_amount, 0) < 0 THEN 'net payable (we owe)'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.net_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'net receivable (owed to us)'
    ELSE 'flat'
  END                                           AS position_side,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.net_pln, 0), 2)              AS net_pln,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.unrealised_pln, 0), 2)       AS unrealised_pln,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.unrealised_pln, 0) - COALESCE(w.unrealised_week_ago, 0), 2) AS unrealised_change_1w_pln,
  COALESCE(p.overdue_amount, 0)                 AS overdue_amount,
  COALESCE(p.due_30d_amount, 0)                 AS due_30d_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.net_pln, 0)) OVER (), 2)        AS total_net_pln,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.unrealised_pln, 0)) OVER (), 2) AS total_unrealised_pln
FROM m
JOIN vol_1y AS v USING (currency)
LEFT JOIN pos AS p USING (currency)
LEFT JOIN week_ago AS w USING (currency)
ORDER BY m.currency

import json

item = _items[0]["json"]


def as_json(value):
    """Fields can arrive as JSON text depending on the Edit Fields type; accept both."""
    return json.loads(value) if isinstance(value, str) else value


cfg = as_json(item["cfg"])
rows = as_json(item["rows"])
if not rows:
    raise ValueError("No facts returned by BigQuery")

# Rankings are decided here, deterministically, so the model never compares numbers.
top_mover = max(rows, key=lambda r: abs(float(r["chg_1w_pct"])))
top_result = max(rows, key=lambda r: abs(float(r["unrealised_pln"])))

FIELDS = (
    "currency", "mid", "chg_1w_pct", "min_30d", "max_30d", "vol_30d_ann_pct",
    "vol_level", "open_docs", "net_amount", "position_side", "net_pln",
    "unrealised_pln", "unrealised_change_1w_pln", "overdue_amount", "due_30d_amount",
)

facts = {
    "report_date": rows[0]["report_date"],
    "functional_currency": "PLN",
    "total_open_position_pln": rows[0]["total_net_pln"],
    "total_unrealised_fx_result_pln": rows[0]["total_unrealised_pln"],
    "biggest_weekly_rate_move": top_mover["currency"],
    "largest_fx_result_currency": top_result["currency"],
    "currencies": [{k: r[k] for k in FIELDS} for r in rows],
}

SYSTEM = """You write a short weekly FX summary for the CFO of a Polish company whose functional currency is PLN.
You receive facts as JSON. Every number in it is already calculated.

Rules:
- Use only the facts. Never calculate, round, add, subtract or compare numbers yourself.
- Copy every number exactly as written in the facts, without rounding or reformatting.
- Negative unrealised values are FX losses, positive values are gains.
- unrealised_change_1w_pln includes both rate moves and documents booked or settled during the week.
- Cover, in this order: the biggest weekly rate move and any currency whose vol_level is not "usual";
  the total open position and the side per currency; the total unrealised FX result and the largest contributor;
  overdue amounts and amounts due within 30 days.
- At most 120 words. Plain text in 3-4 short paragraphs. No markdown, no headings, no bullet points.
- Give no advice on hedging, trading or payments."""

loc = cfg["vertex_location"]
host = "aiplatform.googleapis.com" if loc == "global" else f"{loc}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"
url = (f"https://{host}/v1/projects/{cfg['project']}/locations/{loc}"
       f"/publishers/google/models/{cfg['model']}:generateContent")

body = {
    "systemInstruction": {"parts": [{"text": SYSTEM}]},
    "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": json.dumps(facts, ensure_ascii=False)}]}],
    "generationConfig": {
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "maxOutputTokens": 4096,
        "thinkingConfig": {"thinkingLevel": "low"},
    },
}

return [{"json": {"url": url, "body": body, "facts": facts}}]
